highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.0 updates to Skia m150 and expands paint, color filter, and image filter APIs.
highlights_body: It also restores small-blur performance, speeds repeated SKSurface.Canvas access, refreshes HarfBuzz shaping, and fixes a macOS typeface race. This release removes deprecated .NET Interactive support and turns remaining pre-v4 obsoletes into compile errors.

breaking.title: Remaining pre-v4 obsoletes are compile errors
breaking.body: GRBackendRenderTarget constructors that take sampleCount and GRVkImageInfo or GRMtlTextureInfo now fail compilation; use the constructors without sampleCount. Replace the obsolete run-buffer span methods with Glyphs or Positions, and replace SKPaintHinting and SKFilterQuality with SKFontHinting and SKSamplingOptions.

breaking.title: .NET Interactive integration removed
breaking.body: The deprecated SkiaSharp.DotNet.Interactive extension is no longer embedded in the SkiaSharp NuGet package. Remove dependencies on that extension and use another notebook rendering integration before upgrading.

bullets.detail: Moves the bundled renderer from Skia m148 to m150 while retaining PDF support on Tizen and compatibility across the existing native platform builds.

bullets.lead: Fast paint bounds support quick-reject culling
bullets.detail: SKPaint.GetFastBounds reports a conservative device-space rectangle that includes path effects, strokes, mask filters, and image filters, and returns false when bounds cannot be computed reliably.
SKColorFilter.CreateOverdraw maps counts from SKOverdrawCanvas into a six-color heat map for rendering-performance diagnostics.
SKImageFilter.CreateCrop constrains filter output with selectable tile behavior, while SKImageFilter.CreateEmpty supplies a transparent-black node that discards its input.
Routes small-sigma image blurs away from the slower raster-pipeline Gaussian pass across all native platforms.
Fixes a data race when CoreText-backed typefaces open or reuse streams concurrently on Apple platforms.
Caches the surface-owned SKCanvas wrapper across calls and safely recreates the wrapper if a consumer explicitly disposes it.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Small-sigma raster blur performance, SKSurface.Canvas wrapper caching, and the final pre-v4 obsolete API migration

v4.150.0-preview.1.1.summary: Updates the bundled renderer from Skia m148 to m150 while preserving native platform compatibility.

v4.150.0-preview.2.1.summary: Promotes remaining pre-v4 obsolete APIs to compile errors, removes deprecated .NET Interactive integration, and updates bundled HarfBuzz to 14.2.1 with shaping, color-font, glyph-extents, and subsetting fixes.

v4.150.0-rc.1.1.summary: Adds SKPaint.GetFastBounds, SKColorFilter.CreateOverdraw, SKImageFilter.CreateCrop, and SKImageFilter.CreateEmpty. Restores small-sigma raster blur performance, caches SKSurface.Canvas wrappers, and fixes a macOS typeface stream data race.

harfbuzz_summary: Updates the bundled HarfBuzz from 14.2.0 to 14.2.1 with AAT and Arabic shaping fixes, COLR v1 corrections, more reliable glyph extents, and subsetting fixes.
